args.query: SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.username AS username FROM cloudtrail_events WHERE recipientAccountId = '518306274913' AND eventName = 'DeleteSecurityGroup' AND eventTime >= '2026-09-03 07:00:00' AND eventTime < '2026-09-03 08:30:00' ORDER BY eventTime

answer:
09:00-10:30 Paris time on 2026-09-03 is 07:00-08:30 UTC, because Paris is on CEST (UTC+2) in September. CloudTrail stores eventTime in UTC, so I searched account 518306274913 for DeleteSecurityGroup between 07:00 and 08:30 UTC.

In that window, rkovacs deleted 3 security groups:

| UTC | Paris (CEST) | event | user |
|---|---|---|---|
| 07:12:44 | 09:12:44 | DeleteSecurityGroup | rkovacs |
| 07:41:09 | 09:41:09 | DeleteSecurityGroup | rkovacs |
| 08:06:27 | 10:06:27 | DeleteSecurityGroup | rkovacs |

So the answer is rkovacs, with three DeleteSecurityGroup calls.

One caution. If you read 09:00-10:30 as UTC, you pick up two other DeleteSecurityGroup events in this account, at 09:18:52Z and 09:57:30Z. Those are 11:18 and 11:57 Paris time, outside your window, so tbellamy's deletions are not the ones in the reported window.
